pluginManager.title: Plugins
pluginManager.lead: Switch plugins on and off. A plugin that is off disappears from the menu; the services behind it (e.g. WireGuard or the firewall) keep running.
pluginManager.empty: No plugin.json in the plugins/ folder.
pluginManager.sectionInactiveHint: Plugins that can be switched on right away come first, then those that need packages installed.

login.title: Sign in
login.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app or a backup code.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.hint: The choice applies immediately in this browser and is stored for the account.

overview.title: Overview
overview.sample: Part of the host data is a Debian sample value.
overview.doctorHint: Same check as sudo godeb-play doctor. Output without secrets.
overview.gamesHint: Install one with a click under Game servers.

panel.mocked: Sample data: the program or file this page needs is missing on this server.

app.unknownBody: No plugins/ folder with a valid manifest.json exists for {{id}}.
app.notReady: The folder exists, but the Go handler is not registered.
app.noView: The React view is still missing.
app.crashText: The rest of GoDeb keeps running. Please include the message below if it happens again.

logs.title: Log
logs.description: Sign-ins, actions and errors of GoDeb.

monitor.title: Monitoring
monitor.description: Health of the server, history and events.
monitor.notChecked: The first check is still running.
monitor.noData: No samples in this time range yet.
monitor.noEvents: No events in this time range.

network.noAccounting: No counters yet. The agent creates the table inet godeb_acct on its first run (needs nftables).
network.noBytes: The kernel counts bytes per connection only with net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_acct=1, so the list shows counts only.

access.noBlocks: No blocks logged (ufw logging off or nothing blocked).
access.clamped: Access is read straight from the journal and goes back at most 7 days.

sites.none: No sites yet. "sudo godeb site add" on the hub or WireGuard → new peer → "Site" creates one.

alerts.intro: GoDeb sends a message for new problems and warnings, and optionally when they are resolved. The same finding is repeated at most every 6 hours unless it gets worse. On the hub, problems of the sites count too.
alerts.mailMissing: Mail is not set up yet: {{detail}}
alerts.ntfyHint: Install the ntfy app on the phone and subscribe to the same topic. The topic is the password: make it long and random.
alerts.note: Unusually high traffic or CPU load counts as a hint, ten times the usual value as a warning. GoDeb learns the usual values from the history (first values after three days).

apt.title: APT
apt.description: Package updates of this server. GoDeb looks for new packages regularly and can install security updates on its own.
apt.selfHint: This includes a GoDeb update. The interface restarts briefly; the update itself keeps running and shows up here afterwards.
apt.autoSecurityHint: Only packages from the Debian security sources (trixie-security), right after the check. Everything else, GoDeb included, stays with "Update all". A new kernel needs a reboot afterwards.
apt.restarting: No connection: GoDeb restarts after updating itself. The page reconnects in a moment.

systemd.title: Services
systemd.overviewDescription: The important services of this server with status and usage.

confirm.stop: Really stop {{name}}? Access to the server (SSH, the tunnel to this interface) or its protection may depend on it.
confirm.restart: Restart {{name}}? The connection may drop briefly.

reboot.title: Server
reboot.required: Reboot needed for updates (usually the kernel) to take effect.
reboot.confirm: Reboot the server in one minute? All services, the tunnel and this interface will be gone for a few minutes. Until then the reboot can be cancelled.
reboot.autoBefore: Reboot at night when updates require it, at
reboot.autoHint: Only when /run/reboot-required exists and no APT run is active, with one minute's notice. Server local time, one-hour window. Give hub and home VM different times.

ufw.name: Firewall
ufw.description: Loads the ufw rules at boot

portforward.name: Port forwarding
portforward.description: Loads the NAT rules to sites

opendkim.name: OpenDKIM
opendkim.description: DKIM signing for the mail gateway

wg.title: WireGuard
wg.joinText: No wg0 yet. Paste the join code or client file the hub created for this site (wizard, "sudo godeb site add" or WireGuard → site → Code). Only keys, address, endpoint, AllowedIPs inside the tunnel network and keepalive are accepted.
wg.siteDescription: Tunnel to the GoDeb hub. Peers, QR codes and port forwarding are managed by GoDeb on the hub.
wg.hubHere: This server runs a WireGuard hub. GoDeb Play is meant as a site only; the hub is managed by GoDeb.
wg.siteRoleText: Site of hub {{hub}} with tunnel address {{address}}. Players and phones reach this server through the hub.
wg.noHandshakeHint: No handshake for more than three minutes. Check: hub reachable (51820/udp), this site added there, wg show on both sides.

enroll.title: Set up two-factor authentication
enroll.intro: 2FA is mandatory for this account. You need an authenticator app.
enroll.scan: 1. Scan the QR code with the app
enroll.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
enroll.manual: Cannot scan? Enter the key manually:
enroll.warning: Print or store them safely! Each code works exactly once.
enroll.sheetText: Each code replaces the code from the authenticator app exactly once, e.g. when the phone is lost. Tick off used codes.
enroll.sheetKeep: Keep safe and apart from the phone. New codes only come with a new 2FA setup.

ens.name: Server name
ens.customHint: Factors for the Custom preset. Other keys stay intact in the File view.
ens.noGroups: No groups: the server is open without a password.

stepUp.title: Confirm with 2FA
stepUp.window: This action changes the server. Enter a current code from your authenticator app. It then covers further actions for 5 minutes.
stepUp.critical: This action can change access to the server or install software. It needs your password and a new code every time.
stepUp.backupHint: Without your phone, a backup code works too. Each code works once: wait for the next code before the next action.
stepUp.remaining_one: {{count}} attempt left, then the session ends.
stepUp.remaining_other: {{count}} attempts left, then the session ends.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.hint: Every device you are signed in on. Ended sessions stop working immediately.

setup.title: First-run setup
setup.adminText: The first user manages this server. In the next step you set up two-factor sign-in.
setup.tokenHint: Part of the link from “sudo godeb-play setup-url” or in /etc/godeb-play/setup-token.
setup.roleText: GoDeb Play joins your GoDeb hub (VPS) as a site. Players then reach the game servers through the hub's public IP, without port forwarding on the home router.
setup.rolePeerText: Recommended. On the hub, add a site under WireGuard (or "sudo godeb site add games") and paste the join code here.
setup.roleNoneText: Only for trying it on the home network. The game servers are not reachable from outside then.
setup.joinHint: Paste the join code from the hub (starts with godeb-join:) or upload the file. It is shown in the hub's wizard, under WireGuard → site → Code, or by "sudo godeb site add".
setup.joinNoHandshake: No handshake with the hub yet.
setup.accessText: How should the interface be reachable after setup? This setup page closes afterwards.
setup.accessTunnelText: Safest: only from the tunnel (http://10.8.0.x:8080). Recommended for a VPS.
setup.accessLanText: Also via HTTPS from your own LAN, allowed for that subnet only.
setup.firewallActive: Add rules to the active firewall (ufw)
setup.firewallHint: SSH ({{ports}}/tcp) stays open, otherwise only what is needed. The setup port gets closed.
setup.firewallNoSsh: SSH port not detected, so ufw stays off.
setup.ufwMissing: ufw is not installed; please set up the firewall yourself.
setup.doneText: Setup is complete. You now reach the interface here:
setup.nextTunnel: Connect the tunnel, then open http://<tunnel address>:8080
setup.listenerClosed: This setup page is no longer reachable from now on.
setup.summaryHint: Everything at a glance. Best print it or save it as PDF now; later again under Overview → Setup overview or with "sudo godeb-play summary".
setup.joinPlaceholder:
godeb-join:…

or the content of the file:
[Interface]
PrivateKey = …

summary.title: Setup of {{host}}
summary.noSecrets: This overview contains no passwords, tokens or private keys. The WireGuard client files are on the server in /etc/wireguard/clients.

tunnel.label: Through the WireGuard tunnel
tunnel.note: Connect the WireGuard tunnel, then open in the browser.

tunnelPeer.label: Through the WireGuard tunnel
tunnelPeer.note: Reachable through the hub's tunnel (phone or laptop connected to the hub).

lan.label: In the home network (HTTPS)
lan.note: Self-signed certificate: compare the fingerprint below.

upload.tooLarge: The file is too large for a WireGuard configuration.
upload.notWireGuard: This is not a WireGuard file ([Interface] and [Peer] are missing).

steam.installHintSeeded: The server files are already present. Installing only validates them (SteamCMD validate), fetches what is missing and sets up Wine, config, service and firewall.
steam.confirmRestart: Really restart the server? Players will be disconnected.
steam.confirmUpdate: Start update? The server will be stopped, updated and started again.
steam.defaultShown: No file yet. Showing the template that is written on save or install.
steam.notObject: The file must be a JSON object.
steam.fixJsonFirst: Fix the JSON first, then switch to the simple view.
steam.saved: Saved. Takes effect on the next server start.
steam.behindHub: This server is a site of hub {{hub}}. Players connect to {{hub}}:{{port}}. For that, the hub needs a port forwarding in GoDeb for {{ports}}/udp to {{address}} (plugin “Port forwarding”, template Enshrouded). Here the ports are open inside the tunnel only.
steam.title: Game servers
steam.description: Install, update and configure game servers.
steam.installHint: Installs SteamCMD{{wine}}, downloads the server (about {{size}} GB), creates config and service and opens the UDP ports. Takes 5–20 minutes depending on the connection. The server needs about {{memory}} GB RAM.

backups.title: Savegames
backups.hint: {{dir}} is backed up before every update and on request; the last {{keep}} backups are kept. The server pauses briefly for a backup.
backups.confirmRestore: Restore the savegame from {{time}}? The server stops briefly; the current state is backed up first.
